To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Φ meson is not a good signal for the onset of deconfinement in heavy-ion collisions, and that the Φ mesons are produced by the elementary reaction channels, which are not included in the present transport model.
the Φ meson multiplicity in heavy-ion collisions is strongly affected by the subthreshold Φ production in the elementary reactions ρ + N → Φ + N.

the BUU transport model with a full set of elementary Φ production channels predicts a significant enhancement of the Φ multiplicity compared to the results of a model that includes the elementary Φ production channels only in the reaction channel πN → ΦN, but that the model predictions are still below the experimental data.
